note: Set A covers more ground (e.g. the 6x6 stiffness/inertia matrices and the red shear-web rendering) but is padded with duplicates and several unsupported or misbound claims: invented dimensions (maximum chord 5 m, blade length 135 m and 120 m off 'Z (m)'), shading colors recorded as materials, and vague items like 'webs | red lines'. Set B is shorter and cleaner, keeping the key aft shear web ~50%-of-span fact that A omits, plus the shear web sandwich material and skin/spar cap materials, with only a few misbound 'thickness = shading' entries and an approximate 130/135 m length reading. On balance B has materially fewer wrong claims while retaining the important structural facts.
